title: What does an API integration cost — and when is it worth it?

points.heading: What is an API integration?
points.body: An API (Application Programming Interface) is a way for two software systems to exchange data.

points.heading: What it costs: real numbers
points.body: API integration costs depend on three factors: the quality of the APIs involved, the complexity of the data mapping, and the error handling required.

points.heading: When an API integration pays for itself

cta.sub: API integrations connect your systems and eliminate manual data entry.
